(async () => {

const TAG = "[ONI][Anim][RunFront-SFX-Return]";

const payload = globalThis.__PAYLOAD ?? {};

const DEBUG = true;

const SOUND_SRC = "https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Soundboard/Damage3.ogg";

const IMPACT_VFX_SRC = "modules/JB2A_DnD5e/Library/Generic/Weapon_Attacks/Melee/Group02/TrailAttack02_01_04_Regular_OrangeRed_800x600.webm";

const SOUND_VOLUME = 0.5;

const MOVE_OUT_MS = 320;

const HOLD_MS = 1500; // wait after impact before running back

const MOVE_BACK_MS = 320;

const APPROACH_GAP = 70;

function dbg(...args) {

if (!DEBUG) return;

console.log(TAG, ...args);

}

function warn(...args) {

console.warn(TAG, ...args);

}

function err(...args) {

console.error(TAG, ...args);

}

globalThis.ONI = globalThis.ONI ?? {};

if (!ONI.emit) {

ONI.emit = (eventName, eventPayload = {}, options = {}) => {

const { local = true, world = false } = options;

if (local) Hooks.callAll(eventName, eventPayload);

if (world) game.socket.emit("world", { action: eventName, payload: eventPayload });

};

}

async function toTokenPlaceable(ref) {

if (!ref) return null;

if (typeof ref === "string") {

const byId = canvas.tokens?.get(ref);

if (byId) return byId;

try {

const doc = await fromUuid(ref);

if (!doc) return null;

return doc.object ?? doc.token?.object ?? doc;

} catch (e) {

warn("toTokenPlaceable failed fromUuid:", ref, e);

return null;

}

}

return ref.object ?? ref.token?.object ?? ref ?? null;

}

function uniq(arr) {

return [...new Set(arr.filter(Boolean))];

}

function summarizeToken(tok) {

if (!tok) return null;

return {

id: tok.id ?? null,

name: tok.name ?? tok.document?.name ?? null,

uuid: tok.document?.uuid ?? null,

center: tok.center ? { x: tok.center.x, y: tok.center.y } : null,

x: tok.x ?? null,

y: tok.y ?? null

};

}

async function resolveSourceToken() {

const candidates = [

payload.casterTokenUuid,

payload.sourceTokenUuid,

payload.performerTokenUuid,

payload.tokenUuid,

payload.sourceTokenId,

payload.casterTokenId,

globalThis._token?.document?.uuid,

globalThis.token?.document?.uuid

];

dbg("resolveSourceToken candidates:", candidates);

for (const c of candidates) {

const tok = await toTokenPlaceable(c);

if (tok) return tok;

}

return canvas.tokens?.controlled?.[0] ?? null;

}

async function resolveTargetTokens() {

const raw = uniq([

...(Array.isArray(payload.targetTokenUuids) ? payload.targetTokenUuids : []),

...(Array.isArray(payload.targetUUIDs) ? payload.targetUUIDs : []),

...(Array.isArray(payload.originalTargetUUIDs) ? payload.originalTargetUUIDs : []),

...(Array.isArray(payload.targets) ? payload.targets : []),

...(Array.from(game.user?.targets ?? []).map(t => t?.document?.uuid))

]);

dbg("resolveTargetTokens raw refs:", raw);

const out = [];

for (const r of raw) {

const tok = await toTokenPlaceable(r);

if (tok) out.push(tok);

}

return out;

}

let resolvedSourceToken = null;

let resolvedTargets = [];

try {

if (!game.modules.get("sequencer")?.active) {

ui.notifications.error("Sequencer module is not active.");

return;

}

const sourceToken = await resolveSourceToken();

const targets = await resolveTargetTokens();

const firstTarget = targets[0] ?? null;

resolvedSourceToken = sourceToken;

resolvedTargets = targets;

dbg("Resolved source token:", summarizeToken(sourceToken));

dbg("Resolved targets:", targets.map(summarizeToken));

dbg("Payload snapshot:", payload);

if (!sourceToken) {

ui.notifications.warn("No caster token found.");

return;

}

if (!firstTarget) {

ui.notifications.warn("No target token found.");

return;

}

ONI.emit("oni:animationStart", {

type: "oni.runFrontSfxReturn",

sourceTokenId: sourceToken.id,

targetTokenIds: targets.map(t => t.id),

sceneId: canvas.scene?.id ?? null,

timestamp: Date.now()

}, { local: true, world: false });

const scriptSource = `

const { casterToken, targetTokens, params } = ctx;

if (!casterToken) throw new Error("Need casterToken");

function easeInOutCubic(t) {

return t < 0.5 ? 4 * t * t * t : 1 - Math.pow(-2 * t + 2, 3) / 2;

}

function animateXY(obj, from, to, durMs) {

return new Promise(resolve => {

const start = performance.now();

const ticker = canvas.app.ticker;

const update = () => {

const raw = (performance.now() - start) / durMs;

const t = Math.min(Math.max(raw, 0), 1);

const e = easeInOutCubic(t);

obj.x = from.x + (to.x - from.x) * e;

obj.y = from.y + (to.y - from.y) * e;

if (t >= 1) {

ticker.remove(update);

resolve();

}

};

ticker.add(update);

});

}

function getNativeFlipX(token) {

const values = [

token?.document?.texture?.scaleX,

token?.mesh?.scale?.x,

token?.icon?.scale?.x

].filter(v => typeof v === "number");

if (values.some(v => v < 0)) return true;

const mirrorX = token?.document?.texture?.mirrorX;

if (typeof mirrorX === "boolean") return mirrorX;

return false;

}

function setSpriteFlipX(sprite, flipped) {

const sx = Math.abs(sprite.scale.x || 1);

sprite.scale.x = flipped ? -sx : sx;

}

async function createClone(token) {

const baseObj = token.mesh ?? token.icon;

const texture = baseObj?.texture ?? await loadTexture(token.document.texture.src);

const sprite = new PIXI.Sprite(texture);

sprite.anchor.set(0.5);

const home = { x: token.center.x, y: token.center.y };

sprite.x = home.x;

sprite.y = home.y;

if (baseObj) {

sprite.width = Math.abs(baseObj.width);

sprite.height = Math.abs(baseObj.height);

sprite.alpha = baseObj.worldAlpha ?? 1;

sprite.rotation = baseObj.rotation ?? 0;

}

sprite.zIndex = Number(params.zIndex ?? 5000);

canvas.stage.sortableChildren = true;

canvas.stage.addChild(sprite);

canvas.stage.sortChildren();

setSpriteFlipX(sprite, getNativeFlipX(token));

return sprite;

}

const activeFx = new Set();

async function playImpactVfx(targetToken, src) {

if (!targetToken || !src) return;

let sprite = null;

let cleaned = false;

const cleanup = () => {

if (cleaned) return;

cleaned = true;

try {

const source = sprite?.texture?.baseTexture?.resource?.source;

if (source && typeof source.pause === "function") source.pause();

} catch (_) {}

try {

if (sprite?.parent) sprite.parent.removeChild(sprite);

} catch (_) {}

try {

sprite?.destroy();

} catch (_) {}

activeFx.delete(sprite);

};

try {

const texture = await loadTexture(src);

sprite = new PIXI.Sprite(texture);

activeFx.add(sprite);

sprite.anchor.set(0.5);

const center = targetToken.center ?? { x: 0, y: 0 };

const maxDim = Math.max(targetToken.w ?? 100, targetToken.h ?? 100);

const width = Number(params.impactVfxWidth ?? (maxDim * 2.4));

const height = Number(params.impactVfxHeight ?? (width * 0.75));

sprite.x = center.x;

sprite.y = center.y;

sprite.width = width;

sprite.height = height;

sprite.alpha = Number(params.impactVfxAlpha ?? 1);

sprite.rotation = 0;

sprite.zIndex = Number(params.impactVfxZIndex ?? ((params.zIndex ?? 5000) + 1));

canvas.stage.sortableChildren = true;

canvas.stage.addChild(sprite);

canvas.stage.sortChildren();

const media = texture?.baseTexture?.resource?.source;

if (media) {

try {

media.muted = true;

media.loop = false;

media.currentTime = 0;

} catch (_) {}

if (typeof media.play === "function") {

const playPromise = media.play();

if (playPromise?.catch) playPromise.catch(() => {});

}

if ("onended" in media) {

media.onended = () => cleanup();

}

}

const durationMs =

Number.isFinite(media?.duration) && media.duration > 0

? Math.ceil(media.duration * 1000) + 50

: Number(params.impactVfxFallbackMs ?? 900);

await wait(durationMs);

cleanup();

} catch (e) {

console.error("[ONI][Anim][RunFront-SFX-Return][PseudoVFX] Failed to play impact VFX:", e);

cleanup();

}

}

const baseMesh = casterToken.mesh ?? casterToken.icon;

const originalTokenVisible = casterToken.visible;

const originalMeshVisible = baseMesh?.visible ?? true;

const originalFlipX = getNativeFlipX(casterToken);

const home = { x: casterToken.center.x, y: casterToken.center.y };

const target = targetTokens?.[0] ?? null;

let sprite;

try {

sprite = await createClone(casterToken);

if (baseMesh) baseMesh.visible = false;

casterToken.visible = false;

let front = {

x: home.x + Number(params.fallbackDx ?? -120),

y: home.y

};

if (target) {

const targetCenter = target.center ?? { x: home.x, y: home.y };

const approachDir = home.x >= targetCenter.x ? 1 : -1;

const gap = Number(

params.approachGap ??

Math.max(casterToken.w ?? 100, target.w ?? 100) * 0.6

);

front = {

x: targetCenter.x + (approachDir * gap),

y: targetCenter.y

};

}

// Run in

setSpriteFlipX(sprite, originalFlipX);

await animateXY(

sprite,

home,

front,

Number(params.moveOutMs ?? 320)

);

// Play target impact VFX right when the caster reaches the target.

if (target && params.impactVfxSrc) {

playImpactVfx(target, params.impactVfxSrc);

}

// Hold while the impact window plays

if (Number(params.holdMs ?? 0) > 0) {

await wait(Number(params.holdMs ?? 0));

}

// Flip for the run back

setSpriteFlipX(sprite, !originalFlipX);

await animateXY(

sprite,

front,

home,

Number(params.moveBackMs ?? params.moveOutMs ?? 320)

);

} finally {

for (const fx of Array.from(activeFx)) {

try {

const source = fx?.texture?.baseTexture?.resource?.source;

if (source && typeof source.pause === "function") source.pause();

} catch (_) {}

try {

if (fx?.parent) fx.parent.removeChild(fx);

} catch (_) {}

try {

fx?.destroy();

} catch (_) {}

}

activeFx.clear();

if (sprite) {

canvas.stage.removeChild(sprite);

sprite.destroy();

}

if (baseMesh) baseMesh.visible = originalMeshVisible;

casterToken.visible = originalTokenVisible;

}

`;

dbg("Starting pseudo movement session.");

game.ONI.pseudo.play({

scriptId: "oni.runFrontSfxReturn.flipAware",

scriptSource,

casterTokenUuid: sourceToken.document.uuid,

targetTokenUuids: [firstTarget.document.uuid],

params: {

moveOutMs: MOVE_OUT_MS,

holdMs: HOLD_MS,

moveBackMs: MOVE_BACK_MS,

approachGap: APPROACH_GAP,

fallbackDx: sourceToken.center.x >= firstTarget.center.x ? -120 : 120,

zIndex: 5000,

impactVfxSrc: IMPACT_VFX_SRC,

impactVfxFallbackMs: 900,

impactVfxWidth: Math.max(firstTarget.w ?? 100, firstTarget.h ?? 100) * 2.4,

impactVfxHeight: Math.max(firstTarget.w ?? 100, firstTarget.h ?? 100) * 1.8,

impactVfxAlpha: 1,

impactVfxZIndex: 5001

},

meta: {

source: "RunFrontSfxReturn",

soundSrc: SOUND_SRC,

impactVfxSrc: IMPACT_VFX_SRC

}

});

// Sequencer handles SFX only.

dbg("Starting Sequencer SFX.");

const sfxSeq = new Sequence();

sfxSeq

.wait(MOVE_OUT_MS)

.sound()

.file(SOUND_SRC)

.volume(SOUND_VOLUME);

sfxSeq.play();

// Wait for the whole cinematic window before ending.

await wait(MOVE_OUT_MS + HOLD_MS + MOVE_BACK_MS + 80);

dbg("Animation wait window finished.");

} catch (e) {

err("Animation crashed:", e);

} finally {

try {

ONI.emit("oni:animationEnd", {

type: "oni.runFrontSfxReturn",

sourceTokenId: resolvedSourceToken?.id ?? null,

targetTokenIds: resolvedTargets.map(t => t.id),

sceneId: canvas.scene?.id ?? null,

timestamp: Date.now()

}, { local: true, world: false });

dbg("Emitted oni:animationEnd.", {

sourceTokenId: resolvedSourceToken?.id ?? null,

targetTokenIds: resolvedTargets.map(t => t.id)

});

} catch (e) {

err("Failed to emit animationEnd:", e);

}

}

})();

// ============================================================================

// Pulverize (Foundry VTT v12)

// Flavor:

// 1) Resolve caster + target

// 2) Pseudo clone jumps in an arc to the front of target

// 3) Divine Smite impact VFX plays on target

// 4) Screen flashes with pseudo animation

// 5) Sequencer plays attack SFX

// 6) Caster slides back to original position

//

// NOTE:

// - VFX is handled by Pseudo Animation

// - SFX is handled by Sequencer only

// ============================================================================

(async () => {

const TAG = "[ONI][Anim][Pulverize][v1]";

// -----------------------------

// Assets

// -----------------------------

const ATTACK_VFX =

"modules/JB2A_DnD5e/Library/2nd_Level/Divine_Smite/DivineSmite_01_Regular_BlueYellow_Target_400x400.webm";

const ATTACK_SFX =

"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Hit_SlashingB.wav";

// -----------------------------

// Tunables

// -----------------------------

const JUMP_MS = 360;

const JUMP_ARC_HEIGHT = 90;

const PRE_HIT_MS = 40;

const IMPACT_FALLBACK_MS = 700;

const POST_HIT_MS = 40;

const RETURN_MS = 240;

const FRONT_OFFSET_PX = 70;

const VFX = {

scale: 1.5,

offsetX: 0,

offsetY: 0,

rotationDeg: 0,

fallbackDurationMs: IMPACT_FALLBACK_MS,

zIndex: 999999

};

const FLASH = {

peakAlpha: 0.75,

fadeInMs: 70,

fadeOutMs: 180,

zIndex: 1000000

};

const SFX_VOLUME = 0.90;

const TOTAL_FALLBACK_MS =

JUMP_MS + PRE_HIT_MS + IMPACT_FALLBACK_MS + POST_HIT_MS + RETURN_MS + 120;

// -----------------------------

// Helpers

// -----------------------------

const wait = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, Math.max(0, ms)));

globalThis.ONI = globalThis.ONI ?? {};

if (!ONI.emit) {

ONI.emit = (eventName, payload = {}, options = {}) => {

const { local = true, world = false } = options;

if (local) Hooks.callAll(eventName, payload);

if (world) game.socket.emit("world", { action: eventName, payload });

};

}

function arrify(v) {

if (Array.isArray(v)) return v;

if (v == null) return [];

return [v];

}

function resolveTokenSyncCandidate(candidate) {

if (!candidate) return null;

if (candidate?.center && candidate?.document) return candidate;

if (candidate?.object?.center && candidate?.object?.document) return candidate.object;

if (typeof candidate === "string" && canvas?.tokens?.get(candidate)) {

return canvas.tokens.get(candidate);

}

if (typeof candidate === "string" && typeof fromUuidSync === "function") {

try {

const doc = fromUuidSync(candidate);

const tok = doc?.object ?? null;

if (tok) return tok;

} catch (_) {}

}

return null;

}

async function resolveTokenAsyncCandidate(candidate) {

if (!candidate) return null;

const syncHit = resolveTokenSyncCandidate(candidate);

if (syncHit) return syncHit;

if (typeof candidate === "string") {

try {

const doc = await fromUuid(candidate);

return doc?.object ?? null;

} catch (_) {}

}

return null;

}

function sourceUuidCandidatesFromPayload(p) {

return [

p?.casterTokenUuid,

p?.attackerTokenUuid,

p?.attacker_token_uuid,

p?.attackerTokenUUID,

p?.sourceTokenUuid,

p?.source_token_uuid,

p?.attackerUuid,

p?.sourceUuid,

p?.tokenUuid,

p?.sourceToken?.document?.uuid,

p?.sourceToken?.uuid,

p?.attackerToken?.document?.uuid,

p?.attackerToken?.uuid,

p?.token?.document?.uuid,

p?.token?.uuid,

p?.meta?.casterTokenUuid,

p?.meta?.attackerTokenUuid,

p?.meta?.sourceTokenUuid,

p?.meta?.attackerUuid

].filter(Boolean);

}

function targetCandidatesFromPayload(p) {

return [

...arrify(p?.targetTokenUuids),

...arrify(p?.targetsTokenUuids),

...arrify(p?.targetUuids),

...arrify(p?.originalTargetUUIDs),

...arrify(p?.targetIds),

...arrify(p?.targetTokenIds),

...arrify(p?.meta?.targetTokenUuids),

...arrify(p?.meta?.targetsTokenUuids),

...arrify(p?.meta?.targetUuids),

...arrify(p?.meta?.originalTargetUUIDs),

...arrify(p?.meta?.targetIds),

...arrify(p?.meta?.targetTokenIds),

...arrify(p?.targets),

...arrify(p?.targetTokens),

...arrify(p?.meta?.targets),

...arrify(p?.meta?.targetTokens)

].filter(Boolean);

}

function resolveSourceTokenSync() {

const p = globalThis.__PAYLOAD ?? {};

for (const c of sourceUuidCandidatesFromPayload(p)) {

const tok = resolveTokenSyncCandidate(c);

if (tok) return tok;

}

return canvas?.tokens?.controlled?.[0] ?? null;

}

async function resolveSourceTokenAsync() {

const syncHit = resolveSourceTokenSync();

if (syncHit) return syncHit;

const p = globalThis.__PAYLOAD ?? {};

for (const c of sourceUuidCandidatesFromPayload(p)) {

const tok = await resolveTokenAsyncCandidate(c);

if (tok) return tok;

}

return canvas?.tokens?.controlled?.[0] ?? null;

}

function resolveTargetsSync() {

const p = globalThis.__PAYLOAD ?? {};

const out = [];

for (const c of targetCandidatesFromPayload(p)) {

const tok = resolveTokenSyncCandidate(c);

if (tok && !out.some(t => t.id === tok.id)) out.push(tok);

}

if (!out.length) {

for (const t of game.user.targets) {

if (t && !out.some(x => x.id === t.id)) out.push(t);

}

}

return out;

}

async function resolveTargetsAsync() {

const out = resolveTargetsSync();

if (out.length) return out;

const p = globalThis.__PAYLOAD ?? {};

for (const c of targetCandidatesFromPayload(p)) {

const tok = await resolveTokenAsyncCandidate(c);

if (tok && !out.some(t => t.id === tok.id)) out.push(tok);

}

if (!out.length) {

for (const t of game.user.targets) {

if (t && !out.some(x => x.id === t.id)) out.push(t);

}

}

return out;

}

let sourceToken = null;

let targets = [];

let runId = null;

try {

if (!canvas?.ready) {

ui.notifications.warn("Canvas is not ready yet.");

return;

}

if (!game?.ONI?.pseudo?.play) {

ui.notifications.error("ONI Pseudo Animation API not found: game.ONI.pseudo.play");

return;

}

if (!game.modules.get("sequencer")?.active) {

ui.notifications.error("Sequencer module is not active.");

return;

}

const p = globalThis.__PAYLOAD ?? {};

console.log(TAG, "BOOT", {

payloadKeys: Object.keys(p ?? {}),

sourceCandidates: sourceUuidCandidatesFromPayload(p),

targetCandidates: targetCandidatesFromPayload(p)

});

sourceToken = resolveSourceTokenSync() ?? (await resolveSourceTokenAsync());

targets = resolveTargetsSync();

if (!targets.length) targets = await resolveTargetsAsync();

if (!sourceToken) {

ui.notifications.warn("Pulverize: no caster token found.");

return;

}

if (!targets.length) {

ui.notifications.warn("Pulverize: no target token found.");

return;

}

runId = `${Date.now()}-${foundry.utils.randomID(6)}`;

console.log(TAG, "START", {

runId,

caster: {

id: sourceToken.id,

name: sourceToken.name,

uuid: sourceToken.document.uuid

},

targets: targets.map(t => ({

id: t.id,

name: t.name,

uuid: t.document?.uuid

}))

});

ONI.emit(

"oni:animationStart",

{

type: "skill.pulverize",

runId,

sourceTokenId: sourceToken.id,

sourceTokenUuid: sourceToken.document.uuid,

targetTokenIds: targets.map(t => t.id),

targetTokenUuids: targets.map(t => t.document?.uuid).filter(Boolean),

sceneId: canvas.scene?.id ?? null,

timestamp: Date.now()

},

{ local: true, world: false }

);

const hitDelay = JUMP_MS + PRE_HIT_MS;

const sfxPromise = new Sequence()

.sound()

.file(ATTACK_SFX)

.delay(hitDelay)

.volume(SFX_VOLUME)

.play();

const phaseA = String.raw`

const TAG = "[ONI][Pseudo][Pulverize][PhaseA]";

const { casterToken, targetTokens, params } = ctx;

if (!casterToken) throw new Error("Need casterToken");

if (!targetTokens?.length) throw new Error("Need targetTokens");

if (!canvas?.ready) throw new Error("Canvas not ready");

const wait = (ms) => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, Math.max(0, ms)));

function clamp01(x) {

return Math.min(1, Math.max(0, x));

}

function easeInOutCubic(t) {

return t < 0.5

? 4 * t * t * t

: 1 - Math.pow(-2 * t + 2, 3) / 2;

}

function easeOutQuad(t) {

return 1 - (1 - t) * (1 - t);

}

function getDisp(token) {

const d =

token?.document?.disposition ??

token?.actor?.document?.disposition ??

1;

return d === -1 ? -1 : 1;

}

async function safeLoadTexture(src) {

try {

const fn = foundry?.utils?.preloadTexture ?? globalThis.loadTexture;

if (typeof fn === "function") {

const t = await fn(src);

return t instanceof PIXI.Texture ? t : PIXI.Texture.from(src);

}

} catch (_) {}

try {

if (PIXI?.Assets?.load) {

const t = await PIXI.Assets.load(src);

return t instanceof PIXI.Texture ? t : PIXI.Texture.from(src);

}

} catch (_) {}

return PIXI.Texture.from(src);

}

function animateXY(obj, from, to, durMs) {

return new Promise((resolve) => {

const dur = Math.max(1, Number(durMs) || 1);

const start = performance.now();

const ticker = canvas.app.ticker;

const update = () => {

const raw = (performance.now() - start) / dur;

const t = clamp01(raw);

const k = easeInOutCubic(t);

obj.x = from.x + (to.x - from.x) * k;

obj.y = from.y + (to.y - from.y) * k;

if (t >= 1) {

ticker.remove(update);

resolve();

}

};

ticker.add(update);

});

}

function animateJumpArc(obj, from, to, durMs, arcHeight) {

return new Promise((resolve) => {

const dur = Math.max(1, Number(durMs) || 1);

const height = Number(arcHeight) || 80;

const start = performance.now();

const ticker = canvas.app.ticker;

const update = () => {

const raw = (performance.now() - start) / dur;

const t = clamp01(raw);

const k = easeInOutCubic(t);

obj.x = from.x + (to.x - from.x) * k;

const baseY = from.y + (to.y - from.y) * k;

const arc = Math.sin(Math.PI * t) * height;

obj.y = baseY - arc;

if (t >= 1) {

ticker.remove(update);

obj.x = to.x;

obj.y = to.y;

resolve();

}

};

ticker.add(update);

});

}

async function ensureVideoPlays(texture) {

try {

const res = texture?.baseTexture?.resource;

const vid = res?.source;

if (vid instanceof HTMLVideoElement) {

vid.loop = false;

vid.muted = true;

vid.playsInline = true;

await vid.play().catch(() => {});

return vid;

}

if (typeof res?.play === "function") res.play();

} catch (e) {

console.warn(TAG, "ensureVideoPlays failed:", e);

}

return null;

}

async function getVideoDurationMs(texture, fallbackMs) {

try {

const res = texture?.baseTexture?.resource;

const vid = res?.source;

if (vid instanceof HTMLVideoElement) {

const dur = Number(vid.duration);

if (Number.isFinite(dur) && dur > 0) return Math.round(dur * 1000);

}

} catch (_) {}

return Number(fallbackMs ?? 700);

}

async function createCasterClone(token, zIndex) {

const baseObj = token.mesh ?? token.icon;

const tex = baseObj?.texture ?? await safeLoadTexture(token.document.texture.src);

const sprite = new PIXI.Sprite(tex);

sprite.anchor.set(0.5);

sprite.x = token.center.x;

sprite.y = token.center.y;
